name: Account Closure Process
description: End-to-end procedure for closing customer accounts at FirstUK Bank. Governed by Operations and Retail Banking departments with oversight by the Head of Operations. Effective from 2026-01-15 with scheduled review on 2027-01-15.

name: Branch Staff
description: Front-line staff responsible for executing account closure procedures and interacting with customers during the closure process.
context: Audience | Branch Staff, Operations, Customer Service

name: Operations Staff
description: Operations department personnel responsible for processing and managing account closures as part of the Retail Banking function.
context: Audience | Branch Staff, Operations, Customer Service

name: Customer Service
description: Customer service team responsible for handling customer inquiries and communications related to account closure.
context: Audience | Branch Staff, Operations, Customer Service

name: Head of Operations
description: Senior management role responsible for ownership and oversight of the Account Closure SOP.

name: Account Closure Process
description: End-to-end procedure for closing customer accounts across SmartSaver, Current, and Mortgage products. Covers both customer-initiated closure requests and bank-initiated closures triggered by policy violations, regulatory concerns, or fraud detection.
context: Establish standardized procedures for closing customer accounts (SmartSaver, Current, Mortgage) through customer-initiated requests or bank-initiated closures due to policy violations, regulatory concerns, or fraud.

name: SmartSaver Account
description: Savings account product subject to closure procedures outlined in this document.

name: Current Account
description: Current account product subject to closure procedures outlined in this document.

name: Mortgage
description: Mortgage product subject to closure procedures outlined in this document.

name: Customer Account
description: Generic customer account that may be closed through either customer-initiated request or bank-initiated action.
context: closing customer accounts (SmartSaver, Current, Mortgage) through customer-initiated requests or bank-initiated closures

name: Customer
description: Natural person who holds an account and may initiate closure requests or be subject to bank-initiated account closure.
context: closing customer accounts (SmartSaver, Current, Mortgage) through customer-initiated requests or bank-initiated closures

name: Account Closure Process
description: End-to-end procedure governing the closure of customer accounts across all product types and channels. Covers both customer-initiated closures and bank-initiated closures due to regulatory, fraud, or policy violation reasons. Applies uniformly to savings, current, and mortgage accounts regardless of the channel through which the closure is requested.

name: Savings Account
description: Savings account product subject to the account closure process. Included as one of the product types covered by this SOP.

name: Current Account
description: Current account product subject to the account closure process. Included as one of the product types covered by this SOP.

name: Mortgage
description: Mortgage product subject to the account closure process. Included as one of the product types covered by this SOP.

name: Customer
description: Individual customer who may initiate account closure requests or whose account may be closed by the bank. Defined as a party to the account closure process.

name: Account Closure Process
description: End-to-end procedure for closing a customer account, encompassing identity verification, final balance calculation, standing order and direct debit processing, closure type assessment, balance remittance, and record archival. Applies to both customer-initiated and bank-initiated closures with different timelines and investigation requirements.
context: Timeline: 3–5 business days (customer-initiated), Immediate (bank-initiated with notice)

name: Closure Request Reception
description: Initial step where a closure request is received from the customer or initiated by the bank. This triggers the account closure workflow.

name: Customer Identity Verification
description: Verification step to confirm the identity of the customer requesting account closure or the authorized representative initiating a bank-led closure.

name: Final Balance Calculation
description: Computation of the account's final balance, including all accrued interest, fees, and pending transactions as of the closure date.

name: Standing Order and Direct Debit Processing
description: Processing and cancellation of any active standing orders and direct debit mandates on the account prior to closure.

name: Closure Type Assessment
description: Determination of whether the closure is customer-initiated or bank-initiated, which determines the subsequent workflow path and investigation requirements.

name: Bank-Initiated Closure Investigation
description: Investigation and formal documentation of the reason for bank-initiated account closure, required before proceeding with closure.

name: Final Balance Transfer and Remittance
description: Transfer or remittance of the calculated final balance to the customer via their nominated payment method or account.

name: Closure Confirmation Issuance
description: Issuance of formal written confirmation to the customer documenting the account closure, final balance, and closure date.

name: Record Archival
description: Archival of all account records and documentation for the mandatory retention period of 6 years in compliance with regulatory requirements.

name: Account Status Update to Closed
description: Final system update marking the account status as closed, preventing any further transactions or activity on the account.

name: Closure Type Determination Gate
description: Branching decision point that determines whether the closure is customer-initiated (standard processing path) or bank-initiated (investigation and documentation required path).

name: Customer Account
description: The customer account subject to closure, which transitions from active status through the closure process to final closed status in the system.

name: Account Closure Requestor
description: The customer or authorized representative initiating or subject to account closure, whose identity must be verified and who receives the final balance and closure confirmation.

name: Standing Order
description: Active standing order payment instructions on the account that must be processed and cancelled as part of the account closure procedure.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: Active direct debit mandates on the account that must be processed and cancelled prior to account closure.

name: Operations Staff - Account Closure
description: Operations team responsible for executing the account closure process steps, including identity verification, balance calculation, standing order/direct debit processing, and record archival.

name: Bank-Initiated Closure Investigator
description: Compliance or operations staff responsible for investigating and documenting the reason for bank-initiated account closures.

name: Account Closure Process
description: End-to-end procedure for customer-initiated account closure, encompassing request reception through multiple channels, identity verification, hold confirmation, and customer notification of closure implications. The process begins with request capture and immediate verification actions.
context: Record request (date, time, method, customer contact info)
Explain closure implications (no further transactions, interest stops, records archived)

name: Closure Request Reception
description: Initial capture of customer closure request through multiple channels (branch, phone, online, mail) with collection of required information including account number, customer name, address, closure reason, and payment method preference.
context: Request Channels: Branch, Phone, Online, Mail
Information Required: Account number, Full name, Address, Reason for closure, Preferred method of final payment

name: Request Recording
description: Formal documentation of the closure request in the system, capturing date, time, channel method, and customer contact information for audit and process tracking purposes.
context: Record request (date, time, method, customer contact info)

name: Customer Identity Verification
description: Verification of customer identity using security questions or document verification to confirm the person requesting closure is the authorized account holder.
context: Verify customer identity (security questions or document verification)

name: Account Hold Confirmation
description: Verification that no holds, freezes, disputes, or fraud investigations are active on the account before proceeding with closure.
context: Confirm no holds on account (freezes, disputes, fraud investigation)

name: Closure Implications Notification
description: Communication to the customer of the consequences of account closure, including cessation of transactions, termination of interest accrual, and archival of records.
context: Explain closure implications (no further transactions, interest stops, records archived)

name: Branch Manager
description: Branch-based staff member responsible for receiving in-person closure requests and performing initial verification and notification steps.

name: Customer Service Representative
description: Customer service team member handling phone-based closure requests and performing request recording and verification steps.

name: Head Office Operations Staff
description: Operations staff at head office responsible for processing written closure requests received by mail.

name: Customer Account
description: The customer account subject to closure, identified by account number and held in the customer's name, which may be subject to holds, freezes, or disputes during the closure process.
context: Confirm no holds on account (freezes, disputes, fraud investigation)

name: Individual Customer
description: Natural person initiating the account closure request, required to provide identity verification and specify preferred final payment method.
context: Preferred method of final payment (check, bank transfer, cash)

name: Address Verification
description: Verification of the customer's address as part of identity confirmation during the closure request process.

name: Document Verification
description: Optional document-based identity verification method used as an alternative to security questions to confirm customer identity during closure request.
context: Verify customer identity (security questions or document verification)

name: Bank-Initiated Account Closure
description: End-to-end procedure for closing a customer account initiated by the bank due to regulatory violations, fraud, policy breaches, or dormancy. The process includes documented reasons, customer notification with standard 30-day notice (or immediate closure in emergency scenarios), and account freeze protocols for security risks.
context: Triggers for Bank-Initiated Closure: Regulatory Reason, Fraud, Policy Violation, Dormancy
Emergency Bank-Initiated Closure (No Notice): Immediate account freeze (if fraud/security risk confirmed)

name: Closure Initiation by Manager or Compliance Head
description: The first step in bank-initiated closure where a Manager or Compliance Head formally initiates the account closure process based on identified triggers.

name: Closure Reason Documentation
description: The closure reason is formally documented in the system, categorized as regulatory, fraud, policy, or dormancy-related.
context: Document reason in system (regulatory, fraud, policy)

name: Customer Closure Notice Preparation
description: A formal notice is prepared for the customer explaining the account closure, with standard 30-day notice period except in emergency situations.
context: Prepare notice to customer (30-day notice required, except emergencies)

name: Customer Notification Delivery
description: A letter is sent to the customer explaining the reason for account closure.

name: Emergency Account Freeze
description: In emergency scenarios involving confirmed fraud or security risk, the account is immediately frozen without prior notice to the customer.
context: Immediate account freeze (if fraud/security risk confirmed)

name: Emergency Closure Completion
description: Following an emergency account freeze, the account closure is completed within 7 days with documented reason and same-day customer notification.

name: Manager or Compliance Head
description: The authorized role responsible for initiating bank-initiated account closures and making the decision to close an account based on regulatory, fraud, policy, or dormancy triggers.

name: Closure Trigger Assessment
description: Decision gate determining which closure trigger applies: regulatory violation, fraud, policy breach, or dormancy. This determines the closure pathway and notice requirements.
context: Triggers for Bank-Initiated Closure: Regulatory Reason, Fraud, Policy Violation, Dormancy

name: Emergency vs. Standard Closure Determination
description: Decision point determining whether the closure qualifies as an emergency (fraud/security risk confirmed) requiring immediate freeze and same-day notification, or standard closure with 30-day notice.
context: Emergency Bank-Initiated Closure (No Notice): Immediate account freeze (if fraud/security risk confirmed)

name: Regulatory Compliance Violation Check
description: Mandatory compliance gate verifying whether the closure is triggered by a regulatory violation, AML breach, or regulatory order requiring documented evidence before closure proceeds.
context: Regulatory Reason: Compliance violation, AML breach, regulatory order

name: Fraud and Security Risk Verification
description: Mandatory compliance gate confirming whether fraud or security risk is present, determining whether emergency closure procedures (immediate freeze, same-day notification) are triggered.
context: Fraud: Account used fraudulently, customer identity issue, unauthorized access
Immediate account freeze (if fraud/security risk confirmed)

name: Customer Account
description: The customer account subject to bank-initiated closure due to regulatory, fraud, policy, or dormancy triggers.
context: No activity + failed contact attempts (after 5 years, may close)

name: Customer
description: The individual customer whose account is subject to bank-initiated closure and who receives formal notification of the closure decision.

name: Account Fraud Detection
description: Fraud detection trigger identifying accounts used fraudulently, customer identity issues, or unauthorized access, which may initiate emergency bank-initiated closure procedures.
context: Fraud: Account used fraudulently, customer identity issue, unauthorized access
Immediate account freeze (if fraud/security risk confirmed)

name: AML Breach Screening
description: Anti-Money Laundering screening and monitoring that may identify breaches triggering regulatory-reason bank-initiated account closure.
context: Regulatory Reason: Compliance violation, AML breach, regulatory order

name: Account Verification
description: A discrete verification step that confirms account existence, active status, ownership match, and absence of disputes, legal holds, or fraud investigations before proceeding with the process. Issues trigger escalation to management and compliance, with same-day resolution expected.
context: Account exists and is active (not already closed)
No legal holds (litigation, regulatory investigation, tax lien)

name: Manager/Compliance Head
description: The responsible authority to whom account verification issues are escalated. This role resolves identified problems before the process can proceed.

name: Account Verification Issues Gate
description: A branching condition that determines whether all account verification checks pass. If any issue is found (account inactive, ownership mismatch, disputes, legal holds, or fraud investigation), the path leads to escalation and resolution; otherwise, the process proceeds.

name: Customer Account
description: The subject account being verified in this step. The verification process confirms its active status, ownership, and absence of disputes, legal holds, or fraud investigations.
context: Account exists and is active (not already closed)

name: Balance Calculation Process
description: End-to-end procedure for calculating and documenting a customer account's final balance prior to closure. The process collects all transactions since the last statement, computes the final balance including pending interest and fees, generates a final statement, and obtains operations manager approval and sign-off.
context: Pull all transactions since last statement
Verify balance matches account record in AMS

name: Collect All Transactions
description: Initial step to gather all financial transactions affecting the account since the last statement, including both posted and pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due), with verification that no deposits or withdrawals remain unprocessed.
context: Pull all transactions since last statement
Include pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due)

name: Calculate Final Balance
description: Computation step that determines the account's final balance by combining the ledger balance of posted transactions, adding any accrued but unpaid interest, subtracting pending fees and overdraft charges, and cross-verifying the result against the Account Management System (AMS) record.
context: Add any pending interest (if accrual period not yet completed)
Subtract any pending fees (overdraft, if applicable)
Verify balance matches account record in AMS

name: Document Balance
description: Step to formally record and communicate the final balance by printing a final statement that includes the calculation date, itemizes all pending transactions, and clearly displays the final balance figure.

name: Approval of Final Statement
description: Final authorization step in which the operations manager reviews and verifies the balance calculation, provides formal sign-off on the final statement, and ensures the document is filed in the account closure record.

name: Operations Manager
description: Senior operations staff member responsible for verifying the accuracy of the final balance calculation, authorizing the final statement, and ensuring proper filing of closure documentation.

name: Posted Transaction
description: A financial transaction that has been fully processed and settled on the account ledger, forming the basis of the ledger balance used in final balance calculation.
context: Pull all transactions since last statement

name: Pending Transaction
description: A financial transaction that has been initiated but not yet fully processed or settled, including standing orders and direct debits due, which must be included in the final balance calculation.
context: Include pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due)

name: Standing Order
description: A recurring payment instruction on the account that may be pending at the time of balance calculation and must be included as a pending transaction in the final statement.
context: Include pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due)

name: Direct Debit
description: A direct debit mandate on the account that may be due at the time of balance calculation and must be included as a pending transaction in the final statement.
context: Include pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due)

name: Customer Account
description: The customer account undergoing closure, for which a final balance calculation is performed. The account record is maintained in the Account Management System (AMS) and serves as the verification source for the calculated balance.
context: Verify balance matches account record in AMS

name: Account Management System
description: The automated system that maintains the authoritative account record and serves as the verification source for confirming that the manually calculated final balance matches the system-held account balance.
context: Verify balance matches account record in AMS

name: SmartSaver Account
description: A savings account product used in the closure calculation example. The account holds a ledger balance and accrues pending interest and fees that are calculated as part of the final remittance upon closure.

name: Account Closure Process
description: The end-to-end procedure for closing a SmartSaver Account, which includes calculation of the final balance to remit to the customer, incorporating ledger balance, pending interest, and pending fees.

name: Standing Order Cancellation Process
description: End-to-end procedure for cancelling all future standing orders on a customer account during account closure. Includes execution of final scheduled orders, customer notification, and optional beneficiary notification. Executed on the same day as the closure request.
context: Cancel all future standing orders (effective immediately)
Last standing order executes if scheduled before closure date
Timeline: Same day as closure request

name: Cancel Future Standing Orders
description: Immediate cancellation of all future standing orders on the account, with the exception that any standing order already scheduled for execution before the account closure date will be allowed to execute.
context: Cancel all future standing orders (effective immediately)
Last standing order executes if scheduled before closure date

name: Notify Customer of Standing Order Cancellation
description: Mandatory notification to the customer confirming that all future standing orders have been cancelled as part of the account closure process.

name: Notify Beneficiary of Standing Order Cancellation
description: Optional notification to standing order beneficiary(ies) informing them of the cancellation of future payments due to account closure.

name: Account Closure Operations Staff
description: Operations team member responsible for executing the standing order cancellation actions, including system updates and customer/beneficiary notifications during account closure.
context: Cancel all future standing orders (effective immediately)

name: Standing Order
description: Recurring payment instruction on a customer account that is subject to cancellation during the account closure process. Final standing orders scheduled before closure date are permitted to execute.
context: Cancel all future standing orders (effective immediately)
Last standing order executes if scheduled before closure date

name: Direct Debit Cancellation
description: End-to-end procedure for cancelling all Direct Debit mandates on a customer account effective immediately upon closure request. The bank notifies billers of cancellation while the customer is advised to confirm separately. No further DD transactions can be processed after cancellation.
context: Cancel all Direct Debit mandates (effective immediately)
No further DD transactions can be processed
Timeline: Same day as closure request

name: Cancel Direct Debit Mandates
description: Discrete action to cancel all Direct Debit mandates associated with the customer account, taking effect immediately upon execution.
context: Cancel all Direct Debit mandates (effective immediately)

name: Notify Billers of Cancellation
description: Bank's responsibility to notify all billers of the Direct Debit mandate cancellation as part of the closure process.

name: Advise Customer to Confirm Cancellation with Billers
description: Customer is advised to separately confirm cancellation with billers to ensure they have received the cancellation notice, placing responsibility on the customer for verification.
context: Customer advised to confirm cancellation with billers separately
Customer responsible for ensuring billers received cancellation notice

name: Bank Operations Staff
description: Bank personnel responsible for executing the Direct Debit mandate cancellation and notifying billers as part of the account closure process.

name: Customer
description: The account holder responsible for confirming cancellation with billers separately and ensuring billers have received the cancellation notice.
context: Customer advised to confirm cancellation with billers separately
Customer responsible for ensuring billers received cancellation notice

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: Direct Debit mandates on the customer account that are cancelled effective immediately as part of the account closure process, preventing any further DD transactions from being processed.
context: Cancel all Direct Debit mandates (effective immediately)
No further DD transactions can be processed

name: Account Closure Process
description: End-to-end procedure for closing a customer account, including assessment of closure type, final payment processing, and confirmation notification. The process distinguishes between customer-initiated standard closures and those involving regulatory or fraud concerns.

name: Closure Type Assessment
description: Evaluation step that determines the closure pathway based on whether the customer-initiated request is standard (no regulatory or fraud concerns) or requires special handling. This assessment gates the progression to final payment processing.

name: Final Payment Processing
description: Processing step executed after closure type assessment confirms standard customer-initiated closure. Handles final settlement of account balances and prepares account for termination.

name: Closure Confirmation Notification
description: Final step in standard customer-initiated closure where confirmation of account closure is sent to the customer. Occurs after final payment processing is complete.

name: Closure Type Determination
description: Branching gate that determines whether closure is standard customer-initiated (no regulatory/fraud concerns, account in good standing) or requires escalation due to regulatory or fraud concerns. Routes to standard closure path or special handling.

name: Customer Account
description: The account subject to closure assessment and processing. Referenced as being in good standing during standard customer-initiated closure scenarios.

name: Customer
description: The account holder who initiates the closure request. In standard closure scenarios, the customer voluntarily requests account termination with no regulatory or fraud concerns.

name: Bank-Initiated Account Closure
description: A bank-initiated account closure process triggered by regulatory requirements, fraud detection, or policy violations. The process may involve immediate account freezing followed by a mandatory customer notice period of 7–30 days, with compliance and management approval required throughout.
context: Customer notice (30 days, or immediate if emergency)

name: Document Closure Reason in System
description: The initial step in which the bank records the specific reason for the account closure in the system, establishing the audit trail and compliance record for the closure decision.

name: Compliance and Manager Approval
description: A mandatory approval gate requiring sign-off from both compliance staff and management before the account closure can proceed, ensuring regulatory and policy compliance.

name: Legal Review
description: A conditional legal review step triggered when the account closure has significant financial impact, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation before closure is finalized.

name: Customer Notice
description: Formal notification to the customer of the account closure decision, with a standard notice period of 30 days or immediate notice in emergency scenarios.
context: Customer notice (30 days, or immediate if emergency)

name: Investigation Documentation Attachment
description: The step of attaching investigation documentation and supporting evidence to the closure record in the system, creating a complete audit trail for the closure decision.

name: Compliance Staff
description: The compliance team responsible for approving bank-initiated account closures and ensuring regulatory requirements are met throughout the closure process.

name: Manager
description: The manager responsible for approving the bank-initiated account closure decision alongside compliance staff, ensuring management oversight of the closure.

name: Legal Team
description: The legal team responsible for reviewing account closures with significant financial impact to ensure legal compliance and mitigate risk.

name: Significant Financial Impact Assessment
description: A decision gate determining whether the account closure has significant financial impact, which triggers escalation to legal review if true.

name: Emergency Closure Scenario Assessment
description: A decision gate determining whether the closure is an emergency scenario, which shortens the customer notice period from 30 days to immediate notification.
context: Customer notice (30 days, or immediate if emergency)

name: Regulatory Compliance Gate
description: A mandatory compliance checkpoint ensuring that bank-initiated closures triggered by regulatory requirements are properly documented and approved before proceeding.

name: Fraud Detection Compliance Gate
description: A mandatory compliance checkpoint verifying that fraud-related account closures are properly investigated and documented before customer notification.

name: Account Subject to Bank-Initiated Closure
description: The customer account being closed by the bank due to regulatory, fraud, or policy reasons, which may be frozen during the closure process.

name: Final Balance Payment Process
description: End-to-end procedure for disbursing a customer's final account balance upon account closure. Offers four payment method options (bank transfer, check, cash, or hold) with defined timelines, regulatory limits, and customer communication requirements.
context: Balance held in suspense account (maximum 6 months)
Transferred to unclaimed money fund after 6 months

name: Bank Transfer Initiation
description: Customer provides receiving bank details and transfer is initiated immediately if funds are available. Payment is processed via FPS with 1–2 business day timeline and confirmation sent to customer.

name: Check Issuance and Mailing
description: Check is issued in customer name and mailed to the registered address with a tracking number provided. Payment timeline is 3–5 business days.

name: Cash Payment at Branch
description: Customer collects cash at branch with teller issuing a cash receipt. Payment is immediate but limited to £5,000 per regulatory requirement; larger amounts require check or transfer.

name: Balance Hold in Suspense Account
description: Balance is held in a suspense account for a maximum of 6 months while customer is instructed to provide payment details. A reminder is sent at 3 months, and the balance is transferred to the unclaimed money fund if no instruction is received after 6 months.
context: Balance held in suspense account (maximum 6 months)
Customer instructed to provide payment details
Transferred to unclaimed money fund after 6 months

name: Customer
description: The account holder responsible for selecting a payment method and providing necessary details (bank account, address, or collection instructions) to receive their final balance.
context: Customer instructed to provide payment details

name: Teller
description: Branch staff member responsible for issuing cash payments and providing cash receipts when customers collect their final balance in cash at the branch.

name: Payment Method Selection
description: Customer selects one of four payment methods: bank transfer, check, cash (branch only, up to £5,000), or hold in suspense account. Selection determines the disbursement timeline and process path.

name: Cash Amount Limit Check
description: Decision gate determining whether the final balance can be paid in cash. If amount exceeds £5,000 (regulatory requirement), customer is directed to use check or transfer instead.
context: Larger amounts: Check or transfer recommended

name: Regulatory Cash Payment Limit Compliance
description: Mandatory regulatory control ensuring that cash payments do not exceed £5,000 per transaction. Enforces alternative payment methods (check or transfer) for larger amounts.
context: Larger amounts: Check or transfer recommended

name: Registered Address for Check Mailing
description: The customer's registered address on file to which the check is mailed as part of the final balance payment process.

name: Suspense Account
description: A temporary holding account where the final balance is placed when the customer does not immediately provide payment instructions. The balance is held for a maximum of 6 months before transfer to the unclaimed money fund.
context: Balance held in suspense account (maximum 6 months)
Transferred to unclaimed money fund after 6 months

name: Final Balance Bank Transfer
description: Electronic funds transfer of the final account balance to a customer-provided receiving bank account via FPS, processed within 1–2 business days.

name: Payment Processing
description: End-to-end procedure for processing customer payments via transfer or check, including confirmation of payment method, collection of bank details or address, processing within 5 business days, customer notification, and system recording.

name: Confirm Payment Method with Customer
description: Initial step to establish the customer's preferred payment method before processing.

name: Obtain Bank Details or Address
description: Collection of bank account details for transfer payments or postal address for check payments.
context: Obtain bank details (if transfer) or address (if check)

name: Process Payment
description: Execution of the payment transaction within the specified 5 business day timeline.

name: Confirm Payment Sent to Customer
description: Customer notification confirming that the payment has been dispatched or transferred.

name: Record Payment in System
description: Final step documenting the payment transaction in the system to mark the closure process as complete.

name: Customer Service Representative
description: Role responsible for confirming payment method with customer and obtaining necessary payment details.
context: Obtain bank details (if transfer) or address (if check)

name: Payment Processing System
description: Automated system responsible for executing payment transactions and recording payment details.

name: Customer Payment
description: Financial transaction representing the payment sent to the customer via transfer or check as part of the closure process.

name: Account Closure Process
description: End-to-end procedure for closing a customer account, including status transition from Active to Closed, system updates across customer profile and product statistics, recording of closure date and reason, and implementation of access restrictions. The process executes on the same day as the final payment and triggers automatic deactivation of associated payment instruments and cancellation of recurring payment mandates.
context: Timeline: Same day as final payment

name: Account Status Transition
description: System step that updates the account status from Active to Closed and records the closure date, closure reason, and final balance in the core banking system.

name: Recurring Payment Mandate Cancellation
description: System step that marks all standing orders and direct debits associated with the closed account as Cancelled and blocks any further execution of these recurring payment instructions.

name: Customer Profile Update
description: System step that updates the customer profile to mark the account as closed, ensuring the closure status is reflected in the customer's master record.
context: Customer profile: Account marked as closed

name: Product Statistics Update
description: System step that removes the closed account from the active account count in product statistics, maintaining accurate reporting of active product holdings.
context: Product statistics: Removed from active account count

name: Fraud Detection Exclusion
description: System step that excludes the closed account from ongoing fraud detection and transaction monitoring, as the account is no longer active and poses no operational risk.
context: Fraud detection: Account excluded from monitoring

name: Interest Calculation Termination
description: System step that stops all interest accrual and calculation on the closed account effective from the closure date.
context: Interest calculation: Stops at closure date

name: Online Banking Access Restriction
description: System step that disables online banking access for the closed account, preventing the customer from accessing the account through digital channels.

name: Card Deactivation
description: System step that automatically deactivates any card issued against the closed account, preventing further card transactions.

name: Transaction Block Implementation
description: System step that implements access restrictions on the closed account to prevent any new transactions from being initiated or processed.

name: Banking System
description: Automated system responsible for executing all account closure system updates, including status transitions, link updates, access restrictions, and recurring payment mandate cancellations.

name: Closed Account
description: A customer account that has transitioned from Active status to Closed status as part of the account closure process. The account is subject to access restrictions, transaction blocks, and exclusion from monitoring and interest calculation.

name: Standing Order
description: Standing order payment instructions associated with the closed account that are automatically marked as Cancelled and blocked from further execution upon account closure.

name: Direct Debit
description: Direct debit mandates associated with the closed account that are automatically marked as Cancelled and blocked from further execution upon account closure.

name: Debit Card
description: Payment card issued against the closed account that is automatically deactivated upon account closure, preventing further card transactions.

name: Customer Notification
description: Final step in account closure workflow where customer receives formal closure confirmation letter containing account details, final balance, payment method, and records retention notice. Delivered via email and postal mail to registered address within 2 business days of closure.
context: Sent within 2 business days of closure

name: Customer Service Representative (Notification)
description: Role responsible for preparing and sending the closure confirmation letter to the customer via email and postal mail within the specified timeline.
context: Sent within 2 business days of closure

name: Closed Account
description: The customer account being closed, referenced in the notification letter by account number and product name, with final balance communicated to the customer.

name: Standing Order Cancellation
description: Standing order instruction cancelled as part of account closure, with cancellation confirmation included in the closure notification letter to the customer.

name: Direct Debit Cancellation
description: Direct debit mandate cancelled upon account closure, with cancellation confirmation provided to the customer in the closure letter.

name: Registered Address
description: Customer's registered address on file used as the required delivery address for the postal closure confirmation letter.

name: Account Closing Customer
description: The customer whose account is being closed and who receives the closure confirmation notification letter with account details and final balance.
context: Tone: Professional, thanking customer for business

name: Records Retention Compliance
description: Mandatory compliance notice included in closure letter informing customer that account records will be archived and retained for 6 years as required by regulatory obligations.

name: Record Retention and Archive Process
description: End-to-end procedure for archiving and retaining banking records following account closure. Covers document collection, secure storage in a DMS with encryption and access controls, a mandatory 6-year retention period under POCA and AML Regulations, and secure destruction procedures including shredding, digital deletion, and certificate of destruction.
context: Retention Period: 6 years from closure date (per POCA, AML Regulations)
Storage Location: Secure document management system (DMS), Encrypted, access-controlled
Destruction Procedure: At 6-year mark: Schedule for secure destruction

name: Document Archival Collection
description: Identification and collection of all records required for archival following account closure, including KYC documents, ID verification, address verification, transaction records, account closure request, final statement, payment proofs, and any dispute or complaint records.
context: Records to Archive (6 Years): Account opening documents (KYC, ID, address verification)

name: Secure Storage in Document Management System
